page_title: MCI 0-0 ARS | Manchester City v Arsenal 31/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Rodri (Manchester City) sends a chip pass into the box, but David Raya is quickest to intercept the ball.
90+4' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) brings his opponent down. Anthony Taylor has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the corner.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
88' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
88' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes it short.
87' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
86' A cross into the box from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is cleared.
86' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort under the crossbar is thwarted by Stefan Ortega.
84' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post.
83' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
83' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) sends a long ball in, but Stefan Ortega comfortably gathers the ball.
82' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) finds himself some space inside the penalty box and immediately unleashes a first-time effort. The shot sails well wide of the right post.
80' The corner from Declan Rice (Arsenal) is intercepted by the defence.
80' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.

79' This is an obvious ploy to delay the restart of play from David Raya (Arsenal). This is a yellow card! David Raya (Arsenal) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
78' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Gabriel Martinelli comes onto the pitch to replace him.
77' Kevin De Bruyne races towards the box before laying off to Jeremy Doku (Manchester City), who picks it up but blazes a shot well over the bar from the edge of the box.
76' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

75' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Manchester City.
75' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
74' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 7:4. The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
73' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
72' Substitution. Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) replaces Gabriel Jesus.
71' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
67' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) obviously intended to delay the restart of play and the referee blows the whistle. Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
66' Mikel Arteta prepares a substitution. Jakub Kiwior is replaced by Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal).
66' Here comes a substitution. Thomas Partey (Arsenal) is brought on as a substitute for Jorginho.
65' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
64' A clumsy foul by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle. Manchester City will take a free kick.
64' That's unlucky! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
61' Pep Guardiola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jack Grealish (Manchester City) replacing Mateo Kovacic.
61' We are about to witness a substitution. Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) is replacing Phil Foden.
61' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
60' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Anthony Taylor signals. Manchester City are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
60' Rodri (Manchester City) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
59' The ball is cleared after Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
57' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is flagged for offside.
57' Phil Foden (Manchester City) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

56' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester City can continue in their attacking effort.
54' Handball by Kai Havertz (Arsenal).
52' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Gabriel Jesus.
51' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) tries to find Kai Havertz, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
47' That was close by Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Phil Foden (Manchester City) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
43' The corner from Declan Rice (Arsenal) is cleared away by the defence.
41' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) sends a cross into the box, but David Raya comes off his line to gather the ball.
40' Rodri (Manchester City) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.
38' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul after Declan Rice (Arsenal) hacks down one of his opponents. Manchester City are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
37' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) meets a cross from Josko Gvardiol, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes well wide of the right post.
35' Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
35' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
33' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) tries to find Phil Foden, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
31' Jakub Kiwior links up with Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal), who fires just wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
30' Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) sends a long ball forward to Kai Havertz, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
28' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.

28' Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester City are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
27' Pep Guardiola is forced to make a change. Nathan Ake is unable to continue due to injury, Rico Lewis (Manchester City) comes on.
26' The game is interrupted now, Nathan Ake (Manchester City) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
25' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Anthony Taylor no option but to blow his whistle.
24' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City).
23' 1:1 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:0.
19' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) tackles a bit over-zealously and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
17' The corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is intercepted by Stefan Ortega.
15' Nathan Ake (Manchester City) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes to stop the effort.
15' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) will deliver the corner kick.
15' A cross from Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester City are going to take it.
14' Ben White (Arsenal) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Stefan Ortega intercepts the ball.
12' Rodri (Manchester City) plays a one-two with Erling Haaland, but the move breaks down.
12' The Manchester City players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
10' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to David Raya, who smothers the ball.
7' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) does well to reach an overhit cross into the box from Ben White, but his first-time effort flashes just wide of the left post.
5' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
5' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
4' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
3' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) is penalised for holding. Anthony Taylor signals a set piece. Manchester City win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
2' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Arsenal will have the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor is introduced as the referee for today's match.
